cpu_topology:
# The following is the parsable format, which can be fed to other
# programs. Each different item in every column has an unique ID
# starting usually from zero.
# CPU,Core,Socket
0,0,0
1,0,0
2,1,0
3,1,0
method: Rotate variant order each repetition and reverse short/long order on alternate repetitions. All peers use legacy; when present, repeat and factored use an identical executable path. Cryptographic randomness is not replaced or seeded.
